label: v53.49
changes: Any crew member can now mark any T01-T29 task DONE even when they are not assigned to or working on that task
Added a shared crew completion override button to every open task view, including task previews
The normal DONE button now uses the same crew override so preflight, assignment and existing task holds do not prevent an explicit crew completion
When a task is closed, Navigator removes that task from assignments, active starts and holds, records who closed it, and advances displaced workers to the next open task
Preserved the full project work register, 42.5 mm printable miter template, existing DONE states and shared crew progress
